name: successful-meetings
description: Turn meeting notes into follow-up notes with owned, dated action items. Also builds meeting prep packets and audits recurring meetings: keep, fix, shrink, or kill.

interface.longDescription: Treats meetings as work product with a real cost. Paste raw notes or a transcript and get a Follow-Up Note where every decision is recorded and every action item has an owner and a date. Before a meeting, get a Meeting Packet with an objective, a trimmed attendee list, timeboxed agenda, and pre-reads, or a straight answer on whether it should be an email instead. For recurring meetings, the Meeting Audit returns a keep, fix, shrink, or kill verdict for each one. Built from the Successful Meetings playbook at andrewluxem.com. Static skill: no network calls.
capabilities: Meeting follow-up notes with owned, dated action items
Recurring meeting audits: keep, fix, shrink, or kill
defaultPrompt: Turn these meeting notes into a follow-up note
Audit my weekly team meeting. Should we keep it?
